scope: Draw Figures 1–8 from saved results; no model fitting or participant data required.
mathematical_fonts: Native Computer Modern; fontspec no-math required
scientific_invariants: Figure 1: centered variables and first-argument Bernoulli–KL centroid
Figure 2: I=0.3 and specified dispersion profiles
Figure 3: empirical summaries from adaptive quadrature
Figure 4: lognormal and local hypothetical-design identities
Figure 5: all 72 simulation cells and 24 V=2 loss-ratio comparisons
Figure 6: 27 cross-validation rows using generating-profile diagnostics; nine loss/estimator comparisons
Figure 7: selected 500-replication cells; means and 1.96 MCSE, not site-rank confidence intervals
Figure 8: OCRS summaries, ordered site inputs, and saved posterior draws
source_lock_policy: Check input checksums before drawing. Update recorded checksums only after checking an intentionally replaced input against the paper.
immutable_inputs: Plotting inputs are in analysis/inputs/figure-reference; recalculated results are written to analysis/outputs. Drawing figures does not refit models or update input checksums.
